name: Cosmo Bio Company,Limited
summary: Cosmo Bio Company, Limited is a life science research supplier that imports, exports, manufactures, markets and distributes biotools worldwide. Its range covers biochemical reagents, test kits, analytical software, instruments and diagnostic products, with research reagents such as antibodies, antigens, enzymes, peptides and amino acids, and assay kits for measuring, staining, detecting and purifying.
